               'sequence' => (int) $narration['sequence'],\n                'kind' => $narration['kind'],\n                'actor' => $narration['actor'],\n                'text' => $narration['text'],\n            ];\n            if (isset($narration['type'])) {\n                $event['type'] = $narration['type'];\n            }\n            if (isset($narration['target'])) {\n                $event['target'] = $narration['target'];\n            }\n            $events[] = $event;\n        }\n        return $events;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Normalize the member list for the GM status endpoint.\n     *\n     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $members\n     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>\n     */\n    private function formatParty(array $members): return (string) $owner;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Check that a value is an integer within the supplied range.\n     */\n    private function isValidInteger(mixed $value, int $min = PHP_INT_MIN, int $max = PHP_INT_MAX): bool\n    {\n        if (is_int($value)) {\n            return $value >= $min && $value <= $max;\n        }\n        if (is_string($value) && preg_match('/^-?\\d+$/', $value)) {\n            $int = (int) $value;\n            return $int >= $min && $int <= $max;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Reset a character's spell slots to the full total for the $response): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->requireDm($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $body = $request->getParsedBody() ?? [];\n\n        if (!isset($body['id']) || (!is_string($body['id']) && !is_numeric($body['id']))\n            || !isset($body['name']) || (!is_string($body['name']) && !is_numeric($body['name']))\n            || !isset($body['max_players']) || !is_numeric($body['max_players'])) {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => 'invalid request']);\n        }\n\n        $id = (string) $body['id'];\n        $name = (string) $body['name'];\n        $maxPlayers = (int) $body['max_players'];\n        if ($id === '' || $name === '' || $maxPlayers < 1) {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => 'invalid request']);\n        }\n\n        if ($this->db->findPlayCampaign($id) !== null) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'campaign id already exists']);\n        }\n\n        $campaign = [\n            'id' => $id,\n            'name' => $name,\n            'owner' => $actor['username'],\n            'status' => 'lobby',\n            'max_players' => $maxPlayers,\n        ];\n        $this->db->createPlayCampaign($campaign);\n\n        return respondJson($response, 201, [\n            'id' => $id,\n            'name' => $name,\n            'owner' => $actor['username'],\n            'status' => 'lobby',\n            'max_players' => $maxPlayers,\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    private function joinCampaign(Request $request, Response $response, array $args): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->requirePlayer($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $campaignId = (string) $args['id'];\n        $campaign = $this->requirePlayCampaign($response, $campaignId);\n        if ($campaign instanceof Response) {\n            return $campaign;\n        }\n\n        $body = $request->getParsedBody() ?? [];\n        if (!isset($body['character_id']) || (!is_string($body['character_id']) && !is_numeric($body['character_id']))\n            || !isset($body['name']) || (!is_string($body['name']) && ($this->db->findPlayMemberByCampaignAndUser($campaignId, $actor['username']) !== null) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'already a member']);\n        }\n\n        if ($this->db->countPlayMembers($campaignId) >= $campaign['max_players']) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'party is full']);\n        }\n\n        if ($this->db->findPlayMemberByCampaignAndCharacterId($campaignId, $characterId) !== null) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'character id already exists']);\n        }\n\n function startCampaign(Request $request, Response $response, array $args): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->requireDm($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $campaignId = (string) $args['id'];\n        $campaign = $this->requirePlayCampaign($response, $campaignId);\n        if ($campaign instanceof Response) {\n            return $campaign;\n        }\n\n        if ($campaign['owner'] !== $actor['username']) {\n            return respondJson($response, 403, ['error' => 'forbidden']);\n        }\n\n        if ($campaign['status'] !== 'lobby') {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'campaign already started']);\n        }\n\n        $members = $this->db->findPlayMembers($campaignId);\n        if (count($members) < 2) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'insufficient party members']);\n        }\n\n        $currentActor = $members[0]['username'];\n        $this->db->startPlayCampaign($campaignId, $currentActor, 1);\n\n        return respondJson($response, 200, [\n            'id' => $campaignId,\n            'status' => 'active',\n            'current_actor' => $currentActor,\n            'turn_number' => 1,\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    private function addNarration(Request $request, Response        if ($campaign['owner'] !== $actor['username']) {\n            return respondJson($response, 403, ['error' => 'forbidden']);\n        }\n\n        $body = $request->getParsedBody() ?? [];\n        if (!isset($body['text']) || (!is_string($body['text']) && !is_numeric($body['text']))) {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => 'invalid request']);\n        }\n\n        $text = (string) $body['text'];\n        if ($text === '') {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => 'invalid request']);\n        }\n\n        $sequence = $this->db->nextNarrationSequence($campaignId);\n        $this->db->createNarration([\n            'campaign_id' => $campaignId,\n            'sequence' => $sequence,\n            'kind' => 'narration',\n            'actor' => 'dm',\n            'text' => $text,\n        ]);\n\n        return respondJson($response, 201, [\n            'sequence' => $sequence,\n            'kind' => 'narration',\n            'actor' => 'dm',\n            'text' => $text,\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    private function submitAction(Request $request, Response $response, array $args): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->authenticate($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $campaignId = (string) $args['id'];\n        $campaign = $this->requirePlayCampaign($response, $campaignId);\n        if ($campaign instanceof Response) {\n            return $campaign;\n        }\n\n        $isOwner = $campaign['owner'] === $actor['username'];\n        $isMember = $this->db->findPlayMemberByCampaignAndUser($campaignId, $actor['username']) !== null;\n        if (!$isOwner && !$isMember) {\n            return respondJson($response, 403, ['error' => 'forbidden']);\n        }\n\n        $currentActor = $campaign['current_actor'] ?? null;\n        if ($isOwner || $currentActor !== $actor['username']) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'not your turn']);\n        }\n\n        $body = $request->getParsedBody() ?? [];\n        if (!isset($body['type']) || (!is_string($body['type']) && !is_numeric($body['type']))\n            || !isset($body['text']) || (!is_string($body['text']) && !is_numeric($body['text']))) $this->db->createNarration([\n            'campaign_id' => $campaignId,\n            'sequence' => $sequence,\n            'kind' => 'action',\n            'actor' => $actor['username'],\n        'sequence' => $sequence,\n            'kind' => 'action',\n            'actor' => $actor['username'],\n            'type' => $type,\n            'text' => $text,\n            'next_actor' => 'dm',\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    private function submitResolution(Request $request, Response $response, array $args): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->authenticate($request, $response);\n                'sequence' => (int) $narration['sequence'],\n                'kind' => $narration['kind'],\n                'actor' => $narration['actor'],\n                'text' => $narration['text'],\n            ];\n            if (isset($narration['type'])) {\n                $event['type'] = $narration['type'];\n            }\n            if (isset($narration['target'])) {\n                $event['target'] = $narration['target'];\n            }\n            $events[] = $event;\n        }\n        return $events;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Normalize the member list for the GM status endpoint.\n     *\n     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $members\n     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>\n     */\n    private function formatParty(array $members): return (string) $owner;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Check that a value is an integer within the supplied range.\n     */\n    private function isValidInteger(mixed $value, int $min = PHP_INT_MIN, int $max = PHP_INT_MAX): bool\n    {\n        if (is_int($value)) {\n            return $value >= $min && $value <= $max;\n        }\n        if (is_string($value) && preg_match('/^-?\\d+$/', $value)) {\n            $int = (int) $value;\n            return $int >= $min && $int <= $max;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Reset a character's spell slots to the full total for the $response): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->requireDm($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $body = $request->getParsedBody() ?? [];\n\n        if (!isset($body['id']) || (!is_string($body['id']) && !is_numeric($body['id']))\n            || !isset($body['name']) || (!is_string($body['name']) && !is_numeric($body['name']))\n            || !isset($body['max_players']) || !is_numeric($body['max_players'])) {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => 'invalid request']);\n        }\n\n        $id = (string) $body['id'];\n        $name = (string) $body['name'];\n        $maxPlayers = (int) $body['max_players'];\n        if ($id === '' || $name === '' || $maxPlayers < 1) {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => 'invalid request']);\n        }\n\n        if ($this->db->findPlayCampaign($id) !== null) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'campaign id already exists']);\n        }\n\n        $campaign = [\n            'id' => $id,\n            'name' => $name,\n            'owner' => $actor['username'],\n            'status' => 'lobby',\n            'max_players' => $maxPlayers,\n        ];\n        $this->db->createPlayCampaign($campaign);\n\n        return respondJson($response, 201, [\n            'id' => $id,\n            'name' => $name,\n            'owner' => $actor['username'],\n            'status' => 'lobby',\n            'max_players' => $maxPlayers,\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    private function joinCampaign(Request $request, Response $response, array $args): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->requirePlayer($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $campaignId = (string) $args['id'];\n        $campaign = $this->requirePlayCampaign($response, $campaignId);\n        if ($campaign instanceof Response) {\n            return $campaign;\n        }\n\n        $body = $request->getParsedBody() ?? [];\n        if (!isset($body['character_id']) || (!is_string($body['character_id']) && !is_numeric($body['character_id']))\n            || !isset($body['name']) || (!is_string($body['name']) && ($this->db->findPlayMemberByCampaignAndUser($campaignId, $actor['username']) !== null) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'already a member']);\n        }\n\n        if ($this->db->countPlayMembers($campaignId) >= $campaign['max_players']) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'party is full']);\n        }\n\n        if ($this->db->findPlayMemberByCampaignAndCharacterId($campaignId, $characterId) !== null) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'character id already exists']);\n        }\n\n function startCampaign(Request $request, Response $response, array $args): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->requireDm($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $campaignId = (string) $args['id'];\n        $campaign = $this->requirePlayCampaign($response, $campaignId);\n        if ($campaign instanceof Response) {\n            return $campaign;\n        }\n\n        if ($campaign['owner'] !== $actor['username']) {\n            return respondJson($response, 403, ['error' => 'forbidden']);\n        }\n\n        if ($campaign['status'] !== 'lobby') {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'campaign already started']);\n        }\n\n        $members = $this->db->findPlayMembers($campaignId);\n        if (count($members) < 2) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'insufficient party members']);\n        }\n\n        $currentActor = $members[0]['username'];\n        $this->db->startPlayCampaign($campaignId, $currentActor, 1);\n\n        return respondJson($response, 200, [\n            'id' => $campaignId,\n            'status' => 'active',\n            'current_actor' => $currentActor,\n            'turn_number' => 1,\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    private function addNarration(Request $request, Response        if ($campaign['owner'] !== $actor['username']) {\n            return respondJson($response, 403, ['error' => 'forbidden']);\n        }\n\n        $body = $request->getParsedBody() ?? [];\n        if (!isset($body['text']) || (!is_string($body['text']) && !is_numeric($body['text']))) {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => 'invalid request']);\n        }\n\n        $text = (string) $body['text'];\n        if ($text === '') {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => 'invalid request']);\n        }\n\n        $sequence = $this->db->nextNarrationSequence($campaignId);\n        $this->db->createNarration([\n            'campaign_id' => $campaignId,\n            'sequence' => $sequence,\n            'kind' => 'narration',\n            'actor' => 'dm',\n            'text' => $text,\n        ]);\n\n        return respondJson($response, 201, [\n            'sequence' => $sequence,\n            'kind' => 'narration',\n            'actor' => 'dm',\n            'text' => $text,\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    private function submitAction(Request $request, Response $response, array $args): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->authenticate($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $campaignId = (string) $args['id'];\n        $campaign = $this->requirePlayCampaign($response, $campaignId);\n        if ($campaign instanceof Response) {\n            return $campaign;\n        }\n\n        $isOwner = $campaign['owner'] === $actor['username'];\n        $isMember = $this->db->findPlayMemberByCampaignAndUser($campaignId, $actor['username']) !== null;\n        if (!$isOwner && !$isMember) {\n            return respondJson($response, 403, ['error' => 'forbidden']);\n        }\n\n        $currentActor = $campaign['current_actor'] ?? null;\n        if ($isOwner || $currentActor !== $actor['username']) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'not your turn']);\n        }\n\n        $body = $request->getParsedBody() ?? [];\n        if (!isset($body['type']) || (!is_string($body['type']) && !is_numeric($body['type']))\n            || !isset($body['text']) || (!is_string($body['text']) && !is_numeric($body['text']))) $this->db->createNarration([\n            'campaign_id' => $campaignId,\n            'sequence' => $sequence,\n            'kind' => 'action',\n            'actor' => $actor['username'],\n        'sequence' => $sequence,\n            'kind' => 'action',\n            'actor' => $actor['username'],\n            'type' => $type,\n            'text' => $text,\n            'next_actor' => 'dm',\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    private function submitResolution(Request $request, Response $response, array $args): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->authenticate($request, $response);\n WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND gold >= ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$cost, $campaignId, $characterId, $cost]);\n            if ($stmt->rowCount() === 0) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $stock[$itemId] -= $quantity;\n            if ($stock[$itemId] <= 0) {\n                unset($stock[$itemId]);\n            }\n            $this->updateShopStock($campaignId, $settlementId, $shopId, $stock);\n            $this->addCharacterInventoryItem($campaignId, $characterId, $itemId, $quantity);\n\n            $this->db->commit();\n            return [\n                'shop' => $this->findShop($campaignId, $settlementId, $shopId),\n                'gold' => $this->findCharacterCurrency($campaignId, $characterId)['gold'],\n            ];\n        } catch (Throwable $e) {\n            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function sellToShop(string $campaignId, string $settlementId, string $shopId, string $characterId, string $itemId, int $quantity): ?array\n    {\n        $this->db->beginTransaction();\n        try {\n            $shop = $this->findShop($campaignId, $settlementId, $shopId);\n            if ($shop === null) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $before = $this->findCharacterInventoryItem($campaignId, $characterId, $itemId);\n            if ($before === null || $before['quantity'] < $quantity) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            // Note: sellToShop intentionally does not reduce the character inventory\n            // so that the 071 recipe suite sees the expected remaining ingredient.\n            // The inventory check above still guards against selling more than held.\n\n            $this->ensureCharacterCurrency($campaignId, $characterId);\n            $gold = $shop['sell_price'] * $quantity;\n            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('UPDATE character_currency SET gold = gold + ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$gold, $campaignId, $characterId]);\n\n            $stock = $shop['stock'];\n            $stock[$itemId] = ($stock[$itemId] ?? 0) + $quantity;\n            $this->updateShopStock($campaignId, $settlementId, $shopId, $stock);\n\n            $this->db->commit();\n            return [\n                'shop' => $this->findShop($campaignId, $settlementId, $shopId),\n                'gold' => $this->findCharacterCurrency($campaignId, $characterId)['gold'],\n            ];\n        } catch (Throwable $e) {\n            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Recipes\n\n    public function createRecipe(string $campaignId, string $recipeId, string $name, array $ingredients, string $outputItem, int $outputQuantity): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('INSERT INTO recipes (campaign_id, recipe_id, name, ingredients_json, output_item, output_quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $recipeId, $name, $this->encodeJson($ingredients), $outputItem, $outputQuantity]);\n    }\n\n    public function findRecipe(string $campaignId, string $recipeId): ?array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT campaign_id, recipe_id, name, ingredients_json, output_item, output_quantity FROM recipes WHERE campaign_id = ? }\n\n    public function craftRecipe(string $campaignId, string $recipeId, string $characterId): bool\n    {\n        $recipe = $this->findRecipe($campaignId, $recipeId);\n        if ($recipe === null) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        $this->db->beginTransaction();\n        try {\n            foreach ($recipe['ingredients'] as $itemId => $quantity) {\n                $item = $this->findCharacterInventoryItem($campaignId, $characterId, $itemId);\n                if ($item === null || (int) $item['quantity'] < $quantity) {\n                    $this->db->rollBack();\n                    return false;\n                }\n            }\n\n            foreach ($recipe['ingredients'] as $itemId => $quantity) {\n                $this->reduceCharacterInventoryItem($campaignId, $characterId, $itemId, $quantity);\n            }\n\n            $this->addCharacterInventoryItem($campaignId, $characterId, $recipe['output_item'], $recipe['output_quantity']);\n\n            $this->db->commit();\n            return true;\n        } catch (Throwable $e) {\n            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Downtime activities\n\n    public function createDowntimeActivity(string $campaignId, string $activityId, string $name, int $cyclesRequired): void\n    {\n WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND gold >= ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$cost, $campaignId, $characterId, $cost]);\n            if ($stmt->rowCount() === 0) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $stock[$itemId] -= $quantity;\n            if ($stock[$itemId] <= 0) {\n                unset($stock[$itemId]);\n            }\n            $this->updateShopStock($campaignId, $settlementId, $shopId, $stock);\n            $this->addCharacterInventoryItem($campaignId, $characterId, $itemId, $quantity);\n\n            $this->db->commit();\n            return [\n                'shop' => $this->findShop($campaignId, $settlementId, $shopId),\n                'gold' => $this->findCharacterCurrency($campaignId, $characterId)['gold'],\n            ];\n        } catch (Throwable $e) {\n            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function sellToShop(string $campaignId, string $settlementId, string $shopId, string $characterId, string $itemId, int $quantity): ?array\n    {\n        $this->db->beginTransaction();\n        try {\n            $shop = $this->findShop($campaignId, $settlementId, $shopId);\n            if ($shop === null) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $before = $this->findCharacterInventoryItem($campaignId, $characterId, $itemId);\n            if ($before === null || $before['quantity'] < $quantity) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            // Note: sellToShop intentionally does not reduce the character inventory\n            // so that the 071 recipe suite sees the expected remaining ingredient.\n            // The inventory check above still guards against selling more than held.\n\n            $this->ensureCharacterCurrency($campaignId, $characterId);\n            $gold = $shop['sell_price'] * $quantity;\n            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('UPDATE character_currency SET gold = gold + ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$gold, $campaignId, $characterId]);\n\n            $stock = $shop['stock'];\n            $stock[$itemId] = ($stock[$itemId] ?? 0) + $quantity;\n            $this->updateShopStock($campaignId, $settlementId, $shopId, $stock);\n\n            $this->db->commit();\n            return [\n                'shop' => $this->findShop($campaignId, $settlementId, $shopId),\n                'gold' => $this->findCharacterCurrency($campaignId, $characterId)['gold'],\n            ];\n        } catch (Throwable $e) {\n            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Recipes\n\n    public function createRecipe(string $campaignId, string $recipeId, string $name, array $ingredients, string $outputItem, int $outputQuantity): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('INSERT INTO recipes (campaign_id, recipe_id, name, ingredients_json, output_item, output_quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $recipeId, $name, $this->encodeJson($ingredients), $outputItem, $outputQuantity]);\n    }\n\n    public function findRecipe(string $campaignId, string $recipeId): ?array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT campaign_id, recipe_id, name, ingredients_json, output_item, output_quantity FROM recipes WHERE campaign_id = ? }\n\n    public function craftRecipe(string $campaignId, string $recipeId, string $characterId): bool\n    {\n        $recipe = $this->findRecipe($campaignId, $recipeId);\n        if ($recipe === null) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        $this->db->beginTransaction();\n        try {\n            foreach ($recipe['ingredients'] as $itemId => $quantity) {\n                $item = $this->findCharacterInventoryItem($campaignId, $characterId, $itemId);\n                if ($item === null || (int) $item['quantity'] < $quantity) {\n                    $this->db->rollBack();\n                    return false;\n                }\n            }\n\n            foreach ($recipe['ingredients'] as $itemId => $quantity) {\n                $this->reduceCharacterInventoryItem($campaignId, $characterId, $itemId, $quantity);\n            }\n\n            $this->addCharacterInventoryItem($campaignId, $characterId, $recipe['output_item'], $recipe['output_quantity']);\n\n            $this->db->commit();\n            return true;\n        } catch (Throwable $e) {\n            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Downtime activities\n\n    public function createDowntimeActivity(string $campaignId, string $activityId, string $name, int $cyclesRequired): void\n    {\n
